subject: P5-MS1: remove daemon harness mode — registry fans out to all adapters
description: Delete ZONOID_HARNESS / harness.active() / harness.select() from daemon startup. lib/harness.js becomes a registry only: harness.all(), harness.get(name), harness.route(key) for namespace dispatch. daemon.js always unions Claude native tasks (claude adapter) + file-drop stubs (all harness folders). writeStatus/readTask route by key prefix (<uuid>/… → claude, cursor/… → filedrop/cursor, etc.). fs.watch registers Claude task dir + file-drop dir. No global active adapter. Acceptance: suite green; Claude-only flow byte-identical; cursor/codex stubs aggregate alongside Claude without env var.
